_meta.name: notion
_meta.description: Official Notion MCP via native HTTP transport. Provides read/write access to Notion workspace.
_meta.auth: OAuth — handled natively by Claude Code via /mcp panel
_meta.deploy_cmd: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
_meta.note: NOT in settings.json mcpServers — must be added via claude mcp add. OAuth completes via /mcp in Claude Code.
